'''Stål Aanderaa''' (1 February 1931 – 24 January 2026) was a Norwegian [[mathematician]].

== Biography ==
Aanderaa was born in [[Beitstad]]. He completed the mag.scient. degree in 1959 and his doctorate at [[Harvard University]] in 1966. He was a professor at the [[University of Oslo]] from 1978 to his retirement in 2001.<ref name=snl>{{cite encyclopedia|year=2007|title=Stål Aanderaa|encyclopedia=[[Store norske leksikon]]|editor=Henriksen, Petter|publisher=Kunnskapsforlaget|location=Oslo|url=http://snl.no/St%C3%A5l_Aanderaa|language=Norwegian|accessdate=29 October 2009}}</ref>

Aanderaa was a member of the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Gruppe 1: Matematiske fag |url=http://www.dnva.no/c26848/artikkel/vis.html?tid=27624 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180330143609/http://www.dnva.no/c26848/artikkel/vis.html?tid=27624 |archive-date=2018-03-30 |accessdate=28 October 2009 |publisher=[[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]] |language=Norwegian}}</ref>

== Work ==
Aanderaa is one of the namesakes of the [[Aanderaa–Karp–Rosenberg conjecture]].
